sharedMapEvidence: Not a shared map — a shared absence, established three ways from vendor sources. (1) Table 2 of the Morningstar Product Connectivity Manual, headed 'Morningstar Device MeterBus Power Specifications', enumerates every Morningstar device that can be networked over MeterBus: SunSaver Duo, SunSaver MPPT, ProStar Gen 3, ProStar MPPT, TriStar, TriStar MPPT (150V & 600V), SureSine Classic. The SunSaver P
gotchas: Name collision worth guarding against: the SunSaver MPPT (SS-MPPT-15L) does speak Modbus and shares the 'SunSaver' brand and the '-L' load-terminal suffix with these units. SS-20L-12V and SS-MPPT-15L look alike on a shelf and on an invoice; only one of them can be polled.
The SunLight is the SunSaver design plus lighting control. Its lighting state is visible on the unit's LEDs only — there is no register behind them.

ProStar Gen 1 and Gen 2 belong in this group too, by the same Table 2 evidence, but they are not listed under `models` because the retailer's 'PS-15 / PS-30' listing does not state a generation. See the gotchas on morningstar-prostar-pwm-gen3.
If one of these has to be visible to the gateway, it is visible only through something else — a shunt or an energy meter on its output. Nothing is coming out of the controller.
